The answer says these files turn the opt-out on:

- `library/common.h:132` defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` unconditionally.
- `programs/ssl/ssl_client2.c:8` defines it before any include.
- `programs/ssl/ssl_server2.c:8` also defines it.

The answer also mentions `include/mbedtls/private_access.h`, but only as the file that tests the macro and holds the `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE` wrapper, so I left it out. It mentions `include/mbedtls/ssl.h` only as the place that says the opt-out is deprecated.

ITEMS:
library/common.h
programs/ssl/ssl_client2.c
programs/ssl/ssl_server2.c
END
